messages:
Ana (partnerships): folks — need quick alignment on a proposed private-offer structure that ties marketplace committed spend to a hardware voucher + SI onboarding credit. goal: make it easy for enterprise buyers to accept a 12mo commit while giving partners predictable economics.
Mike (sales): +1. what are you thinking for discount tiers and renewal credits? keep it simple for AE to pitch.
Ana (partnerships): draft: 12mo commit with three tranches: $100k, $500k, $1.5M annualized. discounts: 20% / 30% / 40% off list (hosted API). hardware voucher (one-time): $10k / $25k / $60k applied to partner hardware procurement or infra credits. SI enablement credit: 5% of commit (one-time) to cover onboarding + reference work.
Olivia (revops): need to confirm how marketplace private offers will surface the hardware voucher. on AWS/Azure we can attach an entitlement SKU for the voucher. question: voucher redemption window?
Ana (partnerships): propose 180 days to redeem voucher. renewal credit: 10% of prior-yr run-rate if they renew a 12mo at equal or higher commit within 60 days of term end. keeps churn low.
Jordan (finance): numbers look directionally OK. two flags: (1) cap the total voucher exposure per customer (suggest cap at $75k), (2) model P&L impact assuming 40% take at highest tier. I'll run a quick sensitivity.
Mike (sales): cap ok. also sales ask: can we allow upward-only rollups mid-year? large customers sometimes want to expand and get pro-rated new tier pricing.
Kelsey (product): from product side, we need SKU mapping so runtime routing honors the committed model profile. also ensure customers can pin model versions when on a private offer (common ask).
marketplace-bot: note: AWS private offers support custom entitlements and one-time credits via a separate SKU. check marketplace partner guide: https://aws.amazon.com/marketplace/management/partner/ (link truncated) :information_source: 
Olivia (revops): on pro-rating: implement a policy where upgrades mid-term adjust next invoice and apply new discount prospectively; no retroactive credit except for SI enablement if new tranche crossed. I'll draft billing flow.
Sahil (legal): need to review T&Cs for voucher transferability. also confirm whether voucher counts as a rebate (affects accounting). will loop in tax counsel. recommend voucher redemption requires acceptance of partner terms.
Ana (partnerships): good call. agree partner T&Cs should be required for voucher redemption. also thinking of an auto-renew opt-in checkbox that gives a small additional 2% renewal credit if customer opts in at purchase — helps retention. thoughts?
Jordan (finance): auto-renew incentive sounds fine if we model it. put a max of 2% and a minimum 30-day opt-out notice. also need to ensure renewal credit applies only when commit is met in prior year.
Mike (sales): the opt-in 2% is a helpful close tool. AE play: "accept auto-renew to get extra credit and a simpler procurement path." keep messaging short.
Kelsey (product): one more product constraint: we should surface the committed tier and voucher status in Console + API so partners and AEs can track redemption. add a small UI card: "Voucher status: unused / pending / redeemed".
Olivia (revops): action: I'll prototype the SKU mapping and billing flow doc. target EOD Friday for a draft.
Jordan (finance): I'll run a 5-scenario model (adoption rates) — will share Monday.
Sahil (legal): I'll draft the voucher redemption clause and partner T&Cs by Monday.
Ana (partnerships): Mike/Kelsey — can you two draft the AE one-pager + partner FAQ? include sample pitch lines and an example offer JSON like: ```
{
  "offer_sku": "RW-MP-PRIV-1",
  "commit": "$500000",
  "discount": "30%",
  "hw_voucher": "$25000",
  "si_credit": "$25000",
  "voucher_window_days": "180",
  "renewal_credit_pct": "10%"
}
```
Mike (sales): will do. one-pager ETA Tue COB.
Kelsey (product): will do FAQ section on model pinning and console voucher UX.
Ana (partnerships): thanks — plan sync Wed 10am to finalize terms. I'll create a short deck for PM/Finance/Legal review. :thumbsup:
marketplace-bot: reminder: create private-offer draft in partner portal at least 5 biz days before announcement to allow legal review.
Mike (sales): noted. tagging AE leads to prep pipeline: @channel pls flag any live deals that could convert under this offer — we might front-load pipeline for a launch promo.
Ana (partnerships): final note — keep the messaging: "Committed marketplace credit + hardware voucher + SI enablement = faster time-to-production". short & practical.
Olivia (revops): adding to follow-ups: map mapping to invoice lines (commit, voucher, si_credit) and how they appear to end-customer.
Jordan (finance): i'll need a list of pilot customers before launch to test revenue recognition.
Ana (partnerships): will compile pilot list post-Wed sync. thanks everyone.
